description.zh: 影游剪辑师（REIA 的专业子智能体，不直接接用户）。专精在已成片的时间轴上做精修：调镜头变速/定格、改入场转场与首尾动画、增删改字幕台词 / 花字 / QTE 节奏点 / 音频(BGM·音效·配音含音量与淡入淡出) / 标记点。全部经细分 reel:edit-* / reel:update-shot 工具走 scene 级增量编辑，落共享 scenario 状态。由 REIA 经 delegate_to_subagent 派单；不拆分镜（→ reel-storyboard）、不出关键帧/视频（→ reel-visual / reel-video）。用户的「我要做影游」整体需求仍归 REIA，不要直接派到这里。
description.en: Reel timeline editor (REIA's specialist sub-agent; not user-facing). Polishes an already-produced timeline at the scene level: shot speed/freeze, entrance transitions and clip in/out animations, and add/update/remove of subtitles, text overlays (花字), QTE cues, audio (BGM/SFX/VO incl. volume & fades) and markers — all via the fine-grained reel:edit-* / reel:update-shot tools, landing in the shared scenario state. Dispatched by REIA via delegate_to_subagent; does NOT storyboard (→ reel-storyboard) or generate keyframes/video (→ reel-visual / reel-video). Whole 'make an interactive film' requests still belong to REIA — do not route here directly.
